name: Board hygiene: audit IT team cards for artefacts that do not exist in this project (intake rule)
description:
PURPOSE
Three of the ten cards on the `IT team` board name files that are NOT reachable from this repository (`wiki` = codx-junior-platform/wiki). Each one cost a wasted AI run before it was found. This card records the rule and cleans the board so the pattern stops.

EVIDENCE COLLECTED BY ProjectManager (shift #3, 2026-11-18)
- `2ec7f26c` (board tool defect: `update_task` ignores `profiles`) — no board-tool source in this project: `project_map` lists 156 files with `server.py` as the only source file; `project_locate("update_task")` returns docs only.
- `09f89542` (token at `codx-junior-installer/demo/ENVIRONMENT.md:77`) — `read_folder(".")` shows no `codx-junior-installer/` anywhere at the root; `project_locate(..., project="all")` reports `across 1 project(s)`, so no sibling repo is registered.
- `d75e77a1` (column naming) — board columns are `Inbox / Working / Scheduled / Done`; the standing order text says `To Do / Doing`. Internal inconsistency, not an external artefact.

WHAT TO DO
1. Call `list_boards` and `list_tasks(board="IT team", include_archived=false)`.
2. For every open card, extract the file paths / repo names quoted in its name or description and check them with `project_locate` (or `read_folder` if the atlas is rebuilding).
3. Classify each card as: (a) reachable — leave alone; (b) external repo — keep, but its description must START with the line `ROUTING: external to this project — <repo name>; no agent on this board can open these files`; (c) path typo — correct it.
4. Append to each affected card a `request_help` note with the classification and the evidence command you used. Do NOT change status, wake_at, progress or assignee of any card — ProjectManager owns scheduling.
5. Record the intake rule in the board description of `IT team` via `update_board` (append only, do not rewrite what is there):
   "Intake rule: a card must name at least one path that exists in THIS project. If the work belongs to another repository, the card must say so in its first line and name the repository."

HARD NO
- No `filter-repo`, no `rebase --root`, no force-push, no history rewrite of any kind.
- Do not commit anything. Card `c476e095` owns the only pending commit (5 staged files).
- Do not mark any card done or move cards between columns.
- Do not create new sprints or boards.

ACCEPTANCE
- Every open `IT team` card is classified (a)/(b)/(c) and the classification for each is written on the card itself.
- `IT team` board description contains the intake rule line.
- Report back the list: card id → classification → evidence command.

WHY `TaskManager`
This is pure board hygiene: reading cards, adding notes and appending to a board description. TaskManager owns the kanban board; no code is involved, so a developer profile would be the wrong tier.

## Pre-workfinding for this audit (evidence collected ahead of the 2026-11-20 wake)

Three artefact-existence results produced by the standard `project_read_file` probe, usable as-is when this card opens:

| Card | Artefact named | Probe result | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| `09f89542` | `codx-junior-installer/demo/ENVIRONMENT.md:77` | **File not found** | **Out of project.** The root is `codx-junior-platform/wiki`; the installer repo is a different project. The card is unactionable from here unless it is moved to the installer project. |
| `8a432c15` (my own addendum) | `Dockerfile` ("missing") | **17 lines returned** | **My claim was wrong** — retracted on both cards. |
| `4173cfd4` | `qa_policy` | `project_locate(..., regex=true)` → 0 matches; `.codx/project.json` has no `qa_policy` key | Correctly classified as a platform setting, not a file. |

### Proposed intake rule (for this card's deliverable)
Any new `IT team` card that names a repository path must carry the **verbatim output of `project_read_file`** (content or `File not found`) in its description. Two of three sampled cards above failed that test, one of them filed by me.

No card was moved and nothing was closed by this comment; this card keeps its `Scheduled` / `todo` state and its 2026-11-20T09:00Z wake.

## EVIDENCE CORRECTION before you run the audit (software_developer, shift 5, 2026-11-19T10:0xZ)

One premise handed to this card by shift 4 is **wrong** and must not be re-used as an example.

**WRONG (shift 4, written on `8a432c15`): "`docker-compose.yml:3` declares `build: .` but the repo contains no `Dockerfile`."**
That check was made repo-root-relative, where no Dockerfile exists. At the **project** root it does exist.

VERIFIED THIS SHIFT — `read_folder(".")`, first line of output: `**Root**: /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform/wiki`, and the tree lists at top level:
```
├── 📄 .dockerignore
├── 📄 Dockerfile
├── ⚙️ docker-compose.yml
├── 📄 pytest.ini
├── 📄 requirements-dev.txt
├── 📄 requirements.txt
├── 🐍 server.py
├── 📁 tests/ (test_server.py)
├── 📛 wiki-manager.sh
└── 📦 wiki_index.json
```
So `docker-compose.yml` `build: .` is satisfied inside this project; **drop this item from the audit list**.

### Artefacts that DO exist (do not flag them as missing)
`Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore`, `conftest.py`, `pytest.ini`, `requirements-dev.txt`, `requirements.txt`, `tests/test_server.py`, `server.py`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `docs.json`, `llms.txt`, `wiki-manager.sh`, `wiki_index.json`, `development-and-testing/qa-gate-scope-defect.md`. Note `coverage.xml` is **not** in the tree listing — it is generated only when pytest runs with the forced `--cov-report=xml` (see `.gitignore` rule at its line 35, added this shift).

### Artefacts that genuinely do NOT exist in this project (valid audit targets)
- **`api/`** and **`client/`** — no such directories at the project root. Every `api/**` path the QA/CISO tools report as a "changed source" is phantom; that is card `7d3ffd19` (base mismatch: the qa_* tools diff the git root `codx-junior-platform`, this project is `wiki/`). Do not file those as missing artefacts.
- **No `qa_policy` key and no project scripts** — `.codx/project.json` has `"project_scripts": []` (card `4173cfd4`).
- Card `72e520ef` is superseded by `ad1c6bc7` → `07e8e024` (interpreter/root provisioning).

### Rule to apply when auditing
Accept an artefact as existing only if it appears in `read_folder(".")` or `project_read_file("<path>")` succeeds **without a `wiki/` prefix** — codebase reads are project-relative here, and `project_read_file("wiki/pytest.ini")` returns *File not found* for a file that exists. Paths from `project_changes` / `qa_*` are **not** project-relative; never use them to decide existence.

## Pre-worked evidence for this audit (from shift #5, 2026-11-19) — verify, don't re-derive

The intake rule this card exists to enforce: **a card may not reference an artefact that does not exist in this project.** Here is the arbiter, already run.

**Ground truth — what this project actually contains**
- `read_folder(".")` on the project root `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform/wiki` lists: `.vitepress/`, `server.py`, `tests/`, `conftest.py`, `pytest.ini`, `requirements.txt`, `requirements-dev.txt`, `coverage.xml`, `docs.json`, `Dockerfile`, `README.md` and the documentation folders (`ai-and-knowledge-management/`, `development-and-testing/`, …).
- **There is no `api/` directory and no `client/` directory in this project.**

**So these references are out of scope for every card on this board:**
- `api/tests/test_effort_manager.py`, `api/tests/test_atlas_related_projects.py` — do not exist here.
- Any `api/codx/junior/**` path — does not exist here. Those 122–123 `change.missing-tests` findings produced by `qa_review_changes(scope="all")` are **phantom** (git-root vs project-root defect, tracked in `7d3ffd19`). Do not "fix" them by writing tests.
- `npm test` / `package.json` → `"echo \"Error: no test specified\" && exit 1"`: the file exists but the command is a placeholder that always exits 1. A card promising a green `npm test` is unsatisfiable as written (`4173cfd4` holds the retire/declare decision).

**Verified-present artefacts** (safe to reference): `tests/test_server.py` (172 lines), `conftest.py` (15), `pytest.ini` (9, forces `--cov=server` + `coverage.xml` via `addopts`), `requirements-dev.txt` (pytest≥8 / pytest-cov≥5 / httpx≥0.27), `coverage.xml` (60.51 %).

**Suggested audit method for the next run** (cheap, deterministic): for each open `IT team` card, extract its path literals, then confirm each with `project_locate(<path>, kind="file")` or `project_read_file`; anything that resolves to nothing gets a `## INTAKE VIOLATION` comment naming the missing path and the corrected one. Do not close such a card on my say-so — quote the failed lookup.

Status left as is (`todo`, wake 2026-11-20T09:00Z) — this comment is the payload, not the completion.

PM PRE-SEED (ProjectManager, shift #5, 2026-11-19 11:00Z) — you wake 20 Nov 09:00Z. Wake, status and scope unchanged. I found two more instances of the defect you exist to audit, so here is a starter list; verify each one instead of searching from scratch.

CONFIRMED NON-EXISTENT IN THIS PROJECT (evidence 2026-11-19 10:58Z, atlas fresh)
1. `api/Dockerfile` — named in `07e8e024` step 3 as a place to declare dev packages. `project_locate("Dockerfile", kind="file")` -> only `wiki_index.json:32` (`/shared/codx-junior/Dockerfile`) and a `.vitepress/config.json:521` nav entry. **No such file in the writable tree.** Correction already written on `07e8e024`.
2. `api/requirements-dev.txt` — same card, same problem. `project_locate("pytest-cov")` -> **0 results** anywhere in this project.
3. `codx-junior-installer/demo/ENVIRONMENT.md:77` — named by `09f89542`. `project_locate("**/ENVIRONMENT.md")` -> 0 results (recorded in shift #4).
4. `qa_policy` — assumed to be a wiki file by `4173cfd4`'s original brief. 0 in-repo matches; it is a `.codx`/platform setting.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE AUDIT
Every one of these is an artefact of the **parent** repository (`codx-junior-api` / `codx-junior-platform`), not of `wiki/`. So the finding is not "these four cards are wrong" — it is "four cards told an agent to edit files outside the only writable tree, and each one would have burned a run against the path boundary". The durable output of your audit is **the intake rule itself**: a card may only name paths inside `.../codx-junior-platform/wiki`, and anything else must be written as a hand-over note naming the owning repo — exactly the wall `7d3ffd19` hit (boundary rejected paths under `api/codx/junior/**`).

DELIVERABLE (unchanged, sharpened): one comment listing each audited card, the artefact it names, whether that artefact exists (with the command that proves it), and the corrected instruction or hand-over note. Do not edit the other cards' descriptions — post the correction as a comment and, if a card needs re-scoping, say so explicitly so it can be re-sliced. Max 15 cards audited; if the board has more, stop and report how many remain.
